Turn your home into a wellness retreat with the Santiago 2-person infrared sauna from Golden Designs. Designed for both comfort and function, this premium unit blends innovative low EMF heating technology with natural materials and modern features that elevate your relaxation experience.

Built for two, this compact sauna provides full-body warmth without taking up excess space. It seats two, runs on a standard 120V outlet, and assembles without tools.

Key Features of the Santiago 2-Person Infrared Sauna

This sauna includes seven ultra-efficient carbon heating panels that evenly distribute far infrared heat. Unlike traditional steam saunas, far infrared saunas heat your body directly, not the air around you. This makes them more energy efficient, faster to heat, and easier to tolerate for longer sessions.

The included clasp-together design means the sauna is simple to assemble. It ships in two boxes and fits easily into most indoor spaces including bedrooms, fitness rooms, or spa corners. No plumbing is needed—just plug it into a standard 120V outlet and you’re good to go.

The roof vent ensures comfortable airflow, while the interior’s compact yet ergonomic layout ensures both users can enjoy the experience without feeling cramped.

Why the Santiago 2-Person Infrared Sauna Is a Smart Investment

This 2-person infrared sauna combines advanced heating with red light therapy to deliver results you can feel. Its carbon heating panels are designed to emit very low levels of electromagnetic fields (EMF), making it one of the safest infrared saunas on the market.

Crafted from Canadian Hemlock wood, the Santiago sauna offers durability and a pleasant aroma. The front features a tempered glass door that adds a modern touch while offering a glimpse of the ambient lighting within.

You can control every element from the internal LED control panel, including light settings and temperature. Meanwhile, the built-in Bluetooth sound system lets you play calming music, podcasts, or guided meditation tracks.

What Makes This Sauna Unique

This product stands out with its combination of ultra-low EMF emissions, stylish finish, and smart features. The Bluetooth speaker with pre-amp is a rare inclusion in home sauna models at this price point. The red light chromotherapy lighting system takes the wellness benefits even further, making it more than just a heating unit—it’s a full relaxation experience.

The tempered glass door and clean design blend seamlessly into most interior décor styles. Whether your home is modern or rustic, this sauna looks right at home.

And because it’s made from natural Canadian Hemlock, it resists warping and bacteria buildup while giving off a pleasant natural wood scent during use.
